description: Partially update a schedule — send only the fields you want to change; unset fields keep their current value. Changing recurrence fields recomputes and re-materializes future occurrences. If the change would remove upcoming shifts, nothing is saved and the tool returns confirm_remove_required with the `removed` dates and a `confirm_token`. Show the user those dates; only if they agree, call again with the same changes plus confirm_remove: true and that confirm_token. This tool does NOT change the roster; use assign_contacts_to_schedule for that. Requires the `schedules:write` scope.

confirm_remove.description: Set true to apply a change that removes upcoming shifts, only after the user approved the dates a previous confirm_remove_required result listed. Requires confirm_token from that result.

confirm_token.description: The confirm_token from the confirm_remove_required result for this same change.

custom_dates.description: Explicit list of "yyyy-MM-dd" dates. Required (non-empty) when schedule_type is 'custom'; ignored otherwise.

day_of_month.description: Fixed day of the month for the 'fixed' types. Defaults to 1. Clamped to the last day of shorter months (e.g. 31 in February becomes the 28th/29th).

days_of_week.description: Weekday names this recurs on, e.g. ["tuesday","thursday"]. Required (non-empty) when schedule_type is 'weekly' or 'biweekly'; ignored otherwise.

end_date.description: "yyyy-MM-dd" (account timezone) after which occurrences stop, or null for no end date.

group_id.description: New group id, or null to detach. Unknown ids are ignored.

notes.description: New notes, or null to clear.

nth_weekday.description: The weekday that recurs, for schedule_type 'monthly_nth'/'bimonthly_nth'. Defaults to sunday for those types.

schedule_id.description: The schedule's numeric id (from list_schedules or get_schedule).

schedule_type.description: Recurrence shape. 'weekly' recurs on one or more days of the week; 'biweekly' is the same weekday mask every 14 days (start_date picks which week; not BiMonthly, which is every other month); 'monthly_fixed'/'bimonthly_fixed' recur on a fixed day of the month; 'monthly_nth'/'bimonthly_nth' recur on the Nth weekday of the month; the 'bimonthly_*' variants also alternate months starting from start_month; 'custom' uses an explicit list of dates.

start_date.description: "yyyy-MM-dd" (account timezone) before which no occurrences materialize, or null for no lower bound. For 'biweekly' this also picks which week the 14-day rotation lands on; when omitted, the server uses the first selected weekday after today. Updating an existing biweekly schedule with null keeps its stored date.

start_month.description: Anchor month (1=January … 12=December) the every-other-month cadence steps from, for the 'bimonthly_*' types. Defaults to the account's current month.

time.description: Wall-clock time of day "HH:mm" (24-hour) in the account timezone, or null for no specific time.

week_of_month.description: Which occurrence of the weekday in the month (1st–5th), for the Nth-weekday types. Defaults to 1.

name: update_schedule
title: Update a schedule
